dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Good morning, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hello Rachel, this is Daniel Lim. I've reviewed the general material and called to settle the paperwork. 我现在说话方便，可以把手续谈完。 I'll give you my particulars first. My identification number is F three nine six nine four four two G. My date of birth is 12 December 1989.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Daniel. I'll cover the investment discussion before we turn to the transaction details. To confirm, your objective is long-term capital growth through Asian equities, while diversifying your personal investments away from the family business. With Meridian Asia Equity Fund, weaker corporate earnings or deteriorating regional economic conditions can cause the underlying Asian share prices to fall sharply, reducing the fund's value. Do you understand how those earnings and regional economic risks could cause the fund's value to fall sharply?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I understand. Weaker earnings or regional economic conditions could push the underlying share prices down sharply and reduce the value of my investment.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: You could lose some or all of the capital you invest. The transaction fee is 0.5% of the transaction amount. Are you willing to accept investment losses while pursuing your long-term growth objective?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses and market fluctuations in pursuit of long-term growth.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I recommend this fund because its exposure to Asian companies supports your long-term growth objective and helps broaden your personal investments beyond the family business.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thank you for setting out your recommendation. 我想再问清楚，追求增长和实际结果是不同的，那您能保证将来的回报吗？

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: No, I cannot guarantee future returns. Growth is an investment objective, not a promised outcome.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Separately, could we arrange routine reviews by telephone rather than at the branch? 平时公司的事情比较多，专程过来不太方便。 I would prefer an appointment arranged by email rather than an unexpected call while I'm with our warehouse team.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: We can use email to arrange the appointment and hold the review by telephone. Would you prefer the appointment correspondence to go directly to you, rather than through your office? That would keep the scheduling separate from your business diary.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Directly to me, please. My staff manage delivery appointments, but I keep personal banking out of that calendar. An agenda beforehand would also be useful; otherwise I tend to arrive with a folder of unrelated questions.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: An agenda can help keep the review focused. You can send your administrative questions ahead of the appointment, and we can organise the discussion around those. There is no need to involve your business staff in arranging it.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That would suit my schedule. I still follow regional business developments quite closely, mostly public company announcements and industry interviews. 看企业怎么经营，我觉得很有意思。 Running a distribution business makes me curious about how other management teams organise their operations.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Does that reading fit around your working day, or do you usually set aside time away from the office? I'm asking only so that our review arrangements don't become another interruption to your business.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Usually away from the office. During work I'm moving between the warehouse and customer meetings, so a scheduled conversation is easier. 不用配合我的阅读时间，提前约好就行。 We can leave the review arrangements there and return to today's paperwork.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Certainly. We can leave the diary arrangements for the appointment email. Please set out the transaction details in your own words.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The investment I want for this transaction is Meridian Asia Equity Fund. For the funding, I have Japanese yen available.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Please continue with the remaining details; I'll give you the complete readback afterwards.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That brings us to the end of the call. I'll keep the appointment correspondence separate from your office scheduling, as requested. Thank you for calling, Daniel.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thank you, Rachel. 后续约时间请直接联系我。 Goodbye.
